reason: 该插件的主要面向功能是通过侧边栏提供可视化的技能管理入口：扫描本地技能文件并按来源/分组展示、切换模型与用户可调用开关、以及辅助新建与审查流程；据仓库说明其核心操作对象是本地 SKILL.md 文件和目录，故归类为导航面板类的本地管理工具。

summaries.zh: DSH 技能管理器在侧边栏集中展示并管理本地技能文件，可按来源和分组查看、切换模型/用户调用权限，并通过引导流程协助创建与审查技能。
summaries.en: DSH Skill Manager provides a side-panel UI to manage local skill files, browse them by source and group, toggle model/user invocation settings, and guide skill creation and review workflows.

capabilities: render skill list and grouped views in panel
toggle model/user invocation flags by editing frontmatter
create guided skill folder structure and write/update skill files

reasons.code: Documented sidebar-first workflow for listing, grouping, and switching skills in a management panel
Functionality includes writing SKILL.md frontmatter fields for model/user invocation control and group/subgroup edits
Scope centers on local skill filesystem locations such as ~/.dsh/skills and ~/.agents/skills rather than remote actions
Package config declares a web client entry for the DSH plugin runtime
